array.string: u="__USER_DIR__"; d=$(head -n 1 "$u/domain"); n=$(head -n 1 "$u/nameserver"); case "$d" in *[!a-z0-9.-]*) ;; *.internal) case "$n" in ""|*[!0-9a-f.:]*) ;; *) mkdir -p /etc/resolver; printf 'nameserver %s\n' "$n" >"/etc/resolver/$d" ;; esac ;; esac; if [ -e "$u/enabled" ]; then launchctl kill SIGHUP system/se.ltrf.ltrfnet.nebula; else launchctl kill SIGTERM system/se.ltrf.ltrfnet.nebula; fi
